model_provider.name: agnes
model_provider.reason: Best available existing credential; Agnes free/default text quota is documented around 20 rpm and the model is intended for agent workflows.

older_resident_cane.label: Older resident with cane
older_resident_cane.description: Older Clementi resident who uses a cane and needs short, stable, sheltered trips.

older_resident_walker.label: Older resident with walker
older_resident_walker.description: Older resident using a walker, highly sensitive to kerbs, slopes, rest gaps and surface roughness.

wheelchair_user_commuter.label: Wheelchair user commuter
wheelchair_user_commuter.description: Wheelchair user who needs step-free routes, kerb ramps, bus access, lifts and clear paths.

visually_impaired_commuter.label: Visually impaired commuter
visually_impaired_commuter.description: Commuter who relies on tactile guidance, contrast and predictable crossings.

pma_pmd_user.label: PMA / PMD user
pma_pmd_user.description: Mobility-device user sensitive to bollards, narrow paths and crowded conflict points.

caregiver_with_disabled_person.label: Caregiver with disabled person
caregiver_with_disabled_person.description: Caregiver accompanying someone with mobility or sensory needs.

parent_with_stroller.label: Parent with stroller
parent_with_stroller.description: Parent with stroller who uses ramps, lifts and sometimes competes for bus wheelchair bays.

primary_school_child.label: Primary school child
primary_school_child.description: Child pedestrian concentrated around school peaks and crossings.

secondary_student.label: Secondary student
secondary_student.description: Teen student using bus/MRT and school routes.

poly_uni_student.label: Poly / university student
poly_uni_student.description: Inbound or resident tertiary student drawn by NUS/SIM/SUSS/NP/SP/Dover.

working_adult_commuter.label: Working adult commuter
working_adult_commuter.description: General commuter mass affecting crowding, queueing and path pressure.

delivery_rider_worker.label: Delivery / service worker
delivery_rider_worker.description: Fast-moving worker who can create footpath conflict or temporary obstruction pressure.

note: Rules-based live simulation; free model is reserved for occasional feedback wording/deduplication, not per-agent ticks.
